coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Smith Cardiovascular Research Building
record.summary: The ~236,000 sq ft, five-story headquarters of the UCSF Cardiovascular Research Institute, an L-shaped lab building with wet labs, an outpatient clinic and a vivarium, opened in 2010.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 at 675 Nelson Rising Lane alone is ~13 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.

facts.value: SmithGroup with Jim Jennings Architecture; landscape by Andrea Cochran Landscape Architecture
Cardiovascular research: wet labs, outpatient clinic, vivarium

milestones.text: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings holds a preliminary design review of the Mission Bay Cardiovascular Research Building; the campus reports it is expecting a $100 million cash gift and a matching $50 million gift (bringing gifts in hand toward the ~$254 million project budget) and plans to seek full design approval in November 2007

Images: no plan drawing, elevation or openly-licensed photograph was found for this building specifically. Searched: UCSF Real Estate's Mission Bay campus-site and LRDP pages (realestate.ucsf.edu, blocked to automated fetches with a 403); the UCSF 2014 LRDP EIR's CEQAnet filing (SCH 2013092047, whose pre-2016 attachments aren't hosted on CEQAnet itself); a May 2000 Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings design-approval item for an early Mission Bay building (text-only, no figures); the 2008 "UCSF Mission Bay Planning Principles" appendix (a citywide-scale community map, no individual buildings labeled); and a UCSF wayfinding campus map (not an adopted plan, EIR or permit filing, so not eligible as public-record even though found). Not pursued further in this pass; the record's own project sources above remain the citation for the building's history.

2026-09-21 pass: found a May 2008 Regents item amending this project's budget/financing (to $254,000,000, matching this record's own cost figure) but could not retrieve the original full-approval item's exact date in this pass; the September 2007 preliminary design review, which is dated and clearly building-specific, is used instead as the earlier milestone.
